stepTitle: If the center of gravity of the wheelbarrow and its load has a perpendicular lever arm of $$5.50\, \text{cm}$$ while the hands have a perpendicular lever arm of $$1.02\, \text{m}, $$ what upward force should you exert to support the wheelbarrow and its load if their combined mass is $$55.0\, \text{kg}?$$ Give the force to three significant figures (in $$\text{N})$$.
